comment: Halogenation of aminoacyl-S-carrier (β-tyrosyl-S-SgcC2) in the lidamycin (antibiotic C-1027) pathway.  Non Substrate: 3-hydroxy-β-tyrosyl-S-SgcC2 (L-DOPA). Non substituent: Iodine and fluorine. Stereochemistry could not be depicted due to incompatibility with validation engine.

reactions.description: Chlorination of β-tyrosyl-S-SgcC2. Stereochemistry is determined by SgcC1, therefore SgcC3 functions independently of stereochemistry.
Chlorination in position 3 of carrier-bound L-tyrosine.
In vitro bromination of β-tyrosyl-S-SgcC2. Stereochemistry is determined by SgcC1, therefore SgcC3 functions independently of stereochemistry.
